steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, you can't use the shackles. You've got the bomb inside you!

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: If you ever use the Forbidden Force on my commander, threaten her, or confine her... or if she were to die for any reason, I'll detonate the bomb immediately.

options: He will detonate it eventually whether I use the shackles or not.
He won't know. I'll come up with a solution later.

steps.content: You deploy the shackles, but the bomb doesn't detonate, which means it isn't a self-triggered bomb.
That man has to be present to make a judgement and then detonate the bomb himself. Then there's room for maneuver.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You idiot! How could you put your life on the line like that! You idiot!!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Stop me? You?
Zoya plants herself in front of the altar. The shackles are doing nothing to her stance. The red beams are dancing behind her, and only her face is concealed in the shadows.
The shackles are restraining her, but they are shaking. They're lashed by a tremendous force, and you can feel that a chaotic voice is corrupting the other end of the shackles.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>...He is weak... He can't restrain you!</color>
steps.female_content: <color=#dg1f1f>...She is weak... She can't restrain you!</color>

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Break free from him, destroy him, devour every bit of him... I'll help you break him. I'll make all your wishes a reality...</color>
steps.female_content: <color=#dg1f1f>Break free from her, destroy her, devour every bit of her... I'll help you break her. I'll make all your wishes a reality...</color>

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You ran away from me like a wimp for dear life, and now you crawl back here to stand in my way...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Why? The authorities want the inheritance too? You also want this impure power?

options: There is something that I can't forgive, so I have to fight it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Mania has brought about countless misfortunes. No one should be allowed to use it to make bigger disasters. I dread it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If destroying your enemies at all costs is your idea of determination, then laugh at my cowardice to your heart's content.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I won't let you attain the inheritance... I will not let anyone use it!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hahaha! Is that so? Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I haven't seen people of your ilk for ages. I almost forget that even in a shitty organization like the authorities, there might be someone who doesn't fit in.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Tell me your name, Chief of the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Haha, even that stupid look of bluntness looks familiar.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'll keep that in mind, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, ${PlayerName}, careful! Behind you, something is behind you... Eek!
A mass of black sludge suddenly ensnares her. Before you can say anything, your ankles also fall victim to that sticky substance.
The sticky cold tentacles crawls up quickly and strangles you fiercely. It's contamination in the shape of Horo!

steps.speaker: Horo?
steps.content: Let go... let go of Commander...

steps.speaker: Horo?
steps.content: The inheritance belongs to our commander... Commander... she is our commander!

steps.speaker: Horo?
steps.content: <size=44><color=#dg1f1f>Let go of her, or I'll kill you!</color></size>
You hold on to the shackles tightly, even though the rampant aura is tearing your consciousness into pieces.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Your will is stronger than I thought, but you should fight differently.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, I'll give you a chance to use the shackles on me. Fight through me, but watch your mouth.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You don't want to lose to that thing, right?
The black sludge is tightening its hold on you. But strangely, the tighter it gets, the less willing you are to loosen your hands.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Very good, then all that's left to say is...

steps.speaker: Zoya & You
steps.content: Don't lose!
The two words come out in unison like an incantation. Bright light erupts from the shackles surrounding Zoya and instantaneously severs the shadows that have been crawling towards her.

She dashes, and the next moment, she is standing before you. She clutches the unconscious Horo with one hand, and with the other, she deals a punch that smashes the filthy human-shaped thing clinging to you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Get your hand off the Chief... Ouch!
Clank! Clank! The creatures clinging to your Sinners are also smashed. Zoya grabs the four of you and leaps out of the contamination mire.

options: I didn't know the Forbidden Force could be used this way.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You are shaking so badly. Are you cold?
Zoya is holding you upright with one hand. The last time you were so close, she almost took your life. But this time...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Look at you, scared to death, still, you gave up the chance to escape and came back to the battlefield to stop me...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, That's not cowardice. It's courage, something that's too precious to be found.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You are quite something else. Don't die in a place like this.

steps.speaker: Horo?
steps.content: Commander... Come back... Come back...
The real Horo is lying in the crook of her arm, struggling in pain.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Horo is fighting. I should help her.
